role: Senior Data Analytics and Visualization Engineer

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Participate in architecture and testing processes to ensure they meet best practice specifications
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize testing, best-practice architecture, data security, and CI/CD with no velocity/speed language present, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: you will work with clients from various business domains – Finance, Telecom, Media, Insurance, Oil&Gas, Pharma and others
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Client domains include Finance, Insurance and other regulated sectors but the JD is an EPAM consulting role serving many domains generically with no financial-reporting or regulatory-compliance language of its own, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Manage security and administrate the reporting environment
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: EPAM is a large established consultancy (150+ staff in Latvia alone, 55+ countries) with named tooling, security administration, and architecture processes already in place, indicating a mature operating context.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and build data models, conduct data preparation and profiling / Manage security and administrate the reporting environment
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise technical activities (dashboards, data models, data preparation, security administration, architecture/testing) giving a clear picture of the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Communicate with the Product owner, gather requirements and conduct demo sessions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The named collaboration partner is a Product owner and the work centers on building the reporting/data environment itself, placing this in internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Communicate with the Product owner, gather requirements and conduct demo sessions
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Verbs are largely delivery/support-oriented (build, communicate, gather requirements, perform analysis, manage, participate) rather than direction-setting, so execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is mentioned only in the company benefits section (GenAI Community) describing EPAM's broader capabilities, not as a skill expected of this candidate in the responsibilities/requirements.
evidence.testing_framing: Expertise in data products testing / Participate in architecture and testing processes to ensure they meet best practice specifications
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is named as an owned responsibility and required expertise area (participate in testing processes, expertise in data products testing) rather than a bare tool mention, so responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Manage security and administrate the reporting environment
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: security and testing/architecture best-practice concerns are present but secondary to the delivery-focused dashboard/data-model responsibilities that dominate the JD.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Manage security and administrate the reporting environment / Participate in architecture and testing processes
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role administers and improves an existing reporting environment and architecture rather than building from zero, so fix_scale.
evidence.work_arrangement: This position offers hybrid setup with the flexibility to work from any location in Latvia, whether it's your home or our office in Riga.
evidence.loss_aversion: Manage security and administrate the reporting environment; Participate in architecture and testing processes to ensure they meet best practice specifications. These are named responsibilities but not the dominant framing of the JD.
